title: Colocalization of Yeast Peroxisomal Membrane Proteins Using STED Microscopy
author: Mol, de Lange, et al.

steps.title: Grow and harvest yeast culture
steps.instruction: Grow H. polymorpha cells in mineral medium (MM) + 0.5 % (w/v) glucose for 12–20 h at 37 °C shaking at 200 rpm until stationary; dilute to OD₆₀₀ = 0.1 in the same medium and grow to OD₆₀₀ ≈ 1.6 (≈5 h); dilute again to OD₆₀₀ = 0.1 in MM + 0.5 % (v/v) methanol and grow 4–16 h at 37 °C shaking; harvest 5 OD₆₀₀ units by centrifugation 1 min at 1800 × g, 19–22 °C (Eppendorf 4525).

steps.title: Live‑cell staining and imaging preparation
steps.instruction: Resuspend harvested cells in 500 µL complete MM (with carbon source) containing 1 µM dye (e.g., SiR‑Halo, JF585‑Halo, or SNAP‑Cell 647‑SiR); incubate 1 h at 37 °C shaking in the dark; centrifuge 1 min at 1800 × g, 19–22 °C and discard supernatant; wash once with 1 mL MM without dye and centrifuge again under the same conditions; resuspend in 500 µL dye‑free MM; add the suspension to a live‑cell imaging chamber; place the chamber on a pre‑heated STED microscope kept at 37 °C.

steps.title: Fixed‑cell staining and slide preparation
steps.instruction: Wash cell pellet with 2 mL cold PBS (pH 7.4) and centrifuge 1 min at 1800 × g, 19–22 °C; discard supernatant; resuspend in 500 µL cold 2 % (w/v) formaldehyde in PBS and incubate 30 min on ice; coat ethanol‑washed glass coverslips with Poly‑L‑lysine for 30 min at 19–22 °C in a 12‑well plate, rinse three times with PBS and air‑dry; centrifuge cells 1 min at 1800 × g, 19–22 °C and discard supernatant; wash once with 2 mL PBS, centrifuge and discard supernatant; repeat the wash‑centrifuge step once more; stain by resuspending pellet in 500 µL cold PBS containing 1 µM dye, incubate 1 h at 37 °C shaking in the dark; centrifuge 1 min at 1800 × g, 19–22 °C and discard supernatant; wash three times with 2 mL PBS (centrifuge each wash as above, discarding supernatant); resuspend in 200 µL PBS and pipette onto the coated coverslip in a well of the 12‑well plate; incubate 15 min at 37 °C in the dark; discard solution and wash the coverslip once with PBS; mount the coverslip on a glass microscope slide using Mowiol (invert coverslip); let dry 12–20 h in the dark; store slide at 4 °C in the dark or transfer directly to the STED microscope.

steps.title: Set up Python analysis environment
steps.instruction: Install Python ≥ 3.8.8 and download the analysis workflow from the open‑source repository (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11047200).

steps.title: Transfer and merge image files
steps.instruction: Open the semi‑automated analysis directory; copy all measured .tiff files (confocal and STED) into STED_Pex3_Atg30-Pex3_colocalization/data/sted; merge the 480 nm confocal channel and the 640 nm STED channel into a single stack by running 1_combine_sted_conf.py.

steps.title: Select peroxisome circles in images
steps.instruction: Run 2_click_circles.py; for each displayed stack click near the centre of each peroxisome with the left mouse button (right‑click to reset if needed); press any key to advance to the next image; continue until all images have been processed.

steps.title: Fit circles to peroxisome data
steps.instruction: Depending on the line‑profile shape, run either 3a_fit_circles.py (two peaks) or 3b_fit_small.py (single peak) to automatically fit circles to the selected peroxisomes.

steps.title: Verify and adjust fitted circles
steps.instruction: Run 4_confirm_circles.py; for each image press any key if the fitted circles are correct; if incorrect, left‑click to select the circle and press any key to continue; for images marked incorrect, open 5_manual_circles.ipynb in Jupyter Notebook, choose to exclude the image or manually fit by clicking the centre then the perimeter of each ring.

steps.title: Extract line profiles and statistics
steps.instruction: Run 6_get_data.py to retrieve line profiles of all annotated rings in both channels; then run 7_generate_statistics.py to compute per‑peroxisome and dataset‑wide statistics.
